Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1354
Claimant:
Zachary Arnold
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
07/21/2024
Insured reported a rear-end collision at a low-speed intersection. The claimant's attorney has notified us of
representation and asked that all cotnact go through their office.
08/07/2024
Photos from the scene show damage to the rear bumper and trunk area that lines up with the impact described. The
police report confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision.
08/08/2024
Repair estimate has been received and the damage pattern is consistent with the reported impact. No prior damage
to the vehicle is known from our records or the prior-claims search.
08/28/2024
Claimant reports a wrist injury and was diagnosed with a fracture. The force of the crash appears consistent with this
type of injury, and no earlier injury to the same area is on file.
11/20/2024
Treatment has continued for somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. Medical records are being requested to
review the treatment timeline and any follow-up visits.
11/30/2024
A neighbor contacted us saying they believe the car already had damage several weeks before the reported date of
loss. This is an unverified recollection and has not been confirmed by any other source.
12/07/2024
The claimant has given the same account of the collision in each conversation so far, including the first call, the
recorded statement, and the follow-up with cuonsel present. No independent witnesses have come forward, so the
account rests on the parties and the physical evidence.
12/10/2024
The driver is listed on the policy, and coverage for the date of loss has been confirmed. Liability questions remain
open pending the review of the photos and the police report.
02/06/2025
File is under review. Next steps include obtaining the complete medical records, following up on the neighbor's
comments, and scheduling a final evaluation of the injury claim with the claimant's attorney.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
